lead: A `nvs_repo::scratch` directory (`crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`) fails Novis's ownership check on Windows when the clone sits on a drive whose root grants `Authenticated Users` write
body: , as `E:\` does by default. `target/` inherits that ACL, while the system temp dir under the user profile is owner-only. So a test that runs `rule:config/ownership-is-the-trust-boundary` against its scratch passes in the temp dir and fails under `target/`. Such a test needs a scratch directory locked to the current account, not a plain one.
